question: A student takes a ribbon and burns it in the presence of oxygen. It changes into magnesium oxide. Which process has occurred?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxidation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When** magnesium ribbon** is** burned** in the **presence of oxygen**, magnesium reacts to **generate magnesium oxide.**
